purpose: Original transparent illustrations for Shaikh Mahad's GitHub profile
reference: The first image is original; the other three use the workbench image only for palette and material consistency.

prompts.hero:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Original cutout illustration for a software engineering student's GitHub profile README. It will be integrated next to real typography, so the silhouette must float naturally over both light and dark pages.
Primary request: A beautifully art-directed miniature backend developer's workbench, a tactile editorial illustration with an actual transparent background.
Subject: One warm ivory retro computer with a deep forest-green screen showing only a tiny mint ">_" prompt. A compact cream mechanical keyboard in front. An elegant coral-red angled task lamp leans over it. A small stack of textured notebooks, one open with a few fine pencil diagrams, and a mint-green ceramic pencil cup. A small terracotta cable gently curls out to the left like a drawn flourish. Tiny brass details, a single pale yellow sticky note, nothing cluttered.
Style: Sophisticated stop-motion set design photographed like a luxury editorial still life. Sculpted paper and matte painted wood, visible paper fibers, restrained handmade imperfections, crisp and softly shaded. Charming and personal, not a generic 3D tech icon, not plastic, not glossy. No cartoon people, no logos, no floating UI cards, no clouds, no gradients behind the subject, no neon, no blue-purple tech glow.
Composition: Landscape 3:2 canvas. A close, slightly elevated three-quarter view; the entire compact arrangement fully visible with breathing room around its silhouette. Groundless isolated composition with a small soft contact shadow ONLY immediately beneath the objects. More open space on the left where the loose cable ends. Interesting asymmetrical silhouette and sculptural light.
Palette: warm bone white, pale sage, deep bottle green, burnt coral, tiny ochre accents. Warm natural studio light.
Text: Only ">_" on the monitor. No other lettering, no watermark.
Background: Genuinely transparent alpha, not a drawn checkerboard, no rectangular backdrop, no white background. Preserve translucent edges and shadows.
prompts.linux:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Small transparent illustration to float alongside the LINUX_LAB section in a GitHub README.
Primary request: A charming little Linux study notebook with a tiny handmade penguin perched on it.
Subject: A partly open warm cream notebook with a dark sage cloth cover and rust-red ribbon bookmark. On the open pages, a few subtle pencilled branching lines and a simple terminal prompt "$ _" only. A small sculpted black-and-ivory penguin with warm ochre feet stands on the upper corner of the notebook, leaning curiously toward the page. One coral pencil resting diagonally across the front. A sage paper tab protrudes from the side.
Style: Tactile stop-motion set design / editorial still-life photograph. Matte painted wood, paper fibers, cloth binding, delicate physical detail. Refined and endearing with careful asymmetry; no toy-like glossy plastic. The accompanying reference image is style and materials guidance only; do not reproduce its computer, lamp, plant or arrangement.
Composition: Square canvas, isolated compact arrangement, very clearly readable at 180px display width. The objects occupy about 80% of the canvas, full silhouettes visible, close three-quarter view. Soft warm studio light; only a very small contact shadow. 
Palette: ivory paper, bottle green, sage, terracotta, ochre, warm black.
Background: Actual transparent alpha. No rectangular backdrop, no environment, no glow or broad hazy shadow, no checkerboard. No logos or text except the tiny "$ _" prompt.
prompts.backend:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Transparent cutout editorial illustration for the backend projects section of a personal GitHub README.
Primary request: A little handmade backend machine with three stacked service drawers and an amusingly oversized brass key.
Subject: Three squat modular cream-and-sage metal drawers forming a small vertical server stack, each with one subtle mint indicator light, little ventilation slots and a single brass pull. The top drawer is slightly open revealing tidy paper index cards; two lower drawers shut. A large old-fashioned brass key leans against the stack, and one short coral braided cable curls gently at the base. A tiny cream paper tag tied to the key, blank.
Style: Tactile stop-motion editorial still-life, matte painted wood and softly worn enamel, paper fibers, refined sculptural objects. Match the warm ivory, bottle green, sage, terracotta and brass materials in the reference; the reference is style guidance only. No computer, lamp, plant, desk, keyboard or copied arrangement.
Composition: Square canvas. Entire compact arrangement centered with clear breathing room, all objects fully visible. Close three-quarter view, readable at 160px. Soft warm studio lighting, minimal contact shadow immediately under the objects.
Background: Genuinely transparent alpha. No wall, no floor plane, no broad glow, no drop-shadow rectangle, no checkerboard.
Constraints: No text, no logo, no UI cards, no neon or purple glow, no people, no glossy plastic.
prompts.community:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Transparent cutout illustration beside a student community section in a personal GitHub README.
Primary request: A small, thoughtful sculpture of a shared student noticeboard, with paper messages turning into one paper airplane.
Subject: A tiny freestanding warm oak noticeboard, with a sage fabric pin surface and three overlapping cream notes held with brass pins. Notes have only a few quiet pencil strokes and a small coral hand-drawn heart; no readable words. One note peels from the board into a beautiful cream paper airplane angled upwards to the right, as if a useful idea is being passed on. A coral spool of thread below the board with a short loose curling tail. Compact, welcoming, imaginative.
Style: Refined handcrafted stop-motion editorial still-life, rich paper fibers, matte wood, fabric weave, subtle brass hardware, tactile physical realism. Match the reference's material family and warm palette, but reference is style guidance only; do not reproduce its computer, lamp, plant, desk or notebooks.
Composition: Square transparent canvas. All objects completely in frame with breathing room; noticeboard fills center-left and paper plane lifts into upper-right. Reads clearly at 165px width. Three-quarter view, soft warm studio light, only a delicate shadow immediately beneath the object.
Palette: warm ivory, soft sage, deep bottle green, burnt coral, brass.
Constraints: Actual transparent alpha background. No wall, no floor plane, no broad halo, no checkerboard, no text, no logos, no people, no glossy plastic, no neon.
